newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: WEATHER-LIGHT SHOWERS SEEN OVER PARTS OF S.LANKA.
newsitem.headline: WEATHER-LIGHT SHOWERS SEEN OVER PARTS OF S.LANKA.

text.p: Sri Lanka's metereological department forecast scattered showers accompanied by thunder at times a few places in the Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and isolated showers accompanied by thunder at times in the Western and Southern provinces for Friday.
It said in a statement on Thursday that isolated thunder showers will be experienced over the Eastern and Uva provinces during Friday afternoon or evening.
